cli.//: appVersionSource is REMOTE because this project has a dynamic config (app.config.js). EAS cannot write an auto-incremented buildNumber/versionCode back through a dynamic config, so `local` + `autoIncrement` is not a usable combination here. Remote keeps the counters on EAS; `version` in app.json stays the marketing version you bump by hand.

local-api.//: APK for testing on a real phone against the DEV machine, not production. opescare.test is a hosts-file entry that only resolves on that PC, so the phone must use its LAN address; the Apache vhost carries a matching ServerAlias, without which the phone's Host header falls through to the default vhost and gets a 403. The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi, and this IP is DHCP-assigned — re-check it before rebuilding.

production.//: STORE BUILD. The demo flags below are pinned OFF on purpose: a plain `.env` in the project root is NOT gitignored (only `.env*.local` is) and Expo inlines every EXPO_PUBLIC_* value at bundle time, so a developer's leftover `.env` would otherwise ship the demo sign-in menu and the clinician-preview override to the App Store. An explicit '0' here always wins.

submit.//: Left empty deliberately. Filling this in requires the owner's Apple Developer and Google Play accounts (ascAppId, appleTeamId, the Play service-account JSON) — credentials no agent should hold. See docs/STORE_SUBMISSION.md, runbook steps 1-4.
